taskOrder: frozen pack order, unchanged within every cell

efficiencyTarget.measure: aggregate provider input tokens; serialized tool evidence tokens reported separately
efficiencyTarget.qualityTolerance: zero loss of baseline-delivered original region IDs or applicable source/answer quality per task and repeat

usabilityTarget.measure: unsupported expansion and invalid/stale/foreign selector errors
usabilityTarget.noRegression: candidate error count cannot exceed baseline; per-task source and answer no-regression gates must pass
usabilityTarget.benefit: strictly fewer unsupported expansion errors reported separately from efficiency

lifecycleRequirement: passing live hash-bound receipt independently accepted by coordinator before held-out execution; disposable sources distinct from evaluation library
partialRunPolicy: preserve all attempts; no automatic rerun/resume or exclusions; any infrastructure-only continuation needs a separately versioned coordinator decision, never tuning on answers
reviewRequirement: original source and actual final provider wire; exact delivered region IDs, explicit blank-region verification, table relationships and ordered section completeness; frozen labels never enter model context
promotion: no automatic promotion or full I1 selection; no new foundation/format; keep 20% failure separate from usability findings
interpretation: held-out paired confirmation, not statistical equivalence, architecture selection, production authentication or steady-state latency proof
